title: God's Faithfulness Shines in Unexpected Places
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful story of God's faithfulness and provision in the midst of spiritual warfare. A young woman's extraordinary journey of receiving a generous gift from her uncle, triggered by a past act of kindness, is a testament to God's sovereignty and love. In this sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner will unpack the lessons of faith, obedience, and trust that emerge from this remarkable story.
